title: DISv7: Update IFF Layer 1 to Support DISv7 Records
description: Update the IFF PDU parser to dissect the fields according to the DIS version 7 Specification. Update the display of Mode 1, Mode 2, Mode 3/A, Mode 4, Mode C. Add display of TCAS/ACAS Record, RRB Trandponder Record, and Mode S Interrogator Indentifier Record. Update Enums with the SISO REF 2019 values.

commits_data.message:
DD-6 Added System Designator and System Specific Information

Updated call to dissect_DIS_PARSER_IFF_PDU so that it contains the DIS version.
Updated info column so that it appends text in the right order. Added
System Designator and System Specific Information to DIS v7 IFF PDUs.

commits_data.title: DD-6 Updated Layer 1 Dissection with DIS v7 IFF Layer 1
commits_data.message:
DD-6 Updated Layer 1 Dissection with DIS v7 IFF Layer 1

Added fields that are new to DIS v7. Updated fields to use
add_item instead of add_bits.  Changed the bit_mask of header
field declarations.
